purpose: Machine-readable index of artefacts in plausibility/ that were produced at the WRONG working point (n_A1_gate = 4, the ZENG table default) and therefore must not be cited as results at the frozen point n_A1_gate = 6.
why_this_file_exists: These artefacts previously carried no status field and looked fully authoritative. One of them (rdf_collapse.json, whose verdict reads 'not binding: prefix-preserving collapse probes do not recover bit2') was in fact obtained at n=4, i.e. a configuration the project's own 20-point grid shows always fails. A reviewer was misled by it into retracting a hypothesis that should have stayed open. This index exists so that cannot happen again.

root_cause.mechanism: ThreeBit51Model(..., n_A1_gate=None) makes n_A1_gate_effective fall back to ZENG['n_A'][1], which is 4.0. Any code path that does not pass n_A1_gate explicitly therefore runs at n=4.
root_cause.helper: plausibility_common.build_threebit() and build_decoupled() both leave n_A1_gate as None; measured: build_threebit() -> 4.0, build_decoupled() -> 4.0
root_cause.detection: construct the model and print model.n_A1_gate_effective, or read resolved_params / n_A1_gate_effective in the job metadata where available
root_cause.guard_added: check_local_identifiability.build_with now resolves the COMPLETE parameter vector, passes n_A1_gate explicitly and asserts the realised value; load_jobs refuses to analyse old-format runs

related_hazard_discovered.hazard: ThreeBit51Model._carry1_sources is a STATICMETHOD that reads the global ZENG['n_A'][1] at CALL time, so a global ZENG patch leaks into every other live model instance
related_hazard_discovered.evidence: an A/B equivalence test was first run with arm B's ZENG patch active; arm A's source_F1 then used n=6 instead of 4, showing a spurious difference confined to M_F1 (index 49) and inflated to ~1.0 in the trajectory
related_hazard_discovered.rule: never hold two models whose semantics depend on ZENG at the same time; construct, simulate and compare strictly serially, restoring ZENG between phases
related_hazard_discovered.same_root_as: the retracted check_rdf_collapse v1, which patched ZENG['n_rep']/['K_rep'] globally and destroyed the frozen prefix (reverse_events 14 -> 0)

verified_equivalence.question: is the model-class parameter n_A1_gate = 6 equivalent to the old global ZENG['n_A'] patch to 6 with the F1 drive pinned at 4?
verified_equivalence.method: run model A (class parameter, ZENG clean at n_A[1]=4) and model B (build_decoupled, ZENG patched to 6) in separate ZENG contexts, then compare

measurements.rhs_gap_argmax_index: b2_M_I (index 34), i.e. last-bit noise in the one corrected derivative
measurements.certification: identical (crossings = gates = reverse_events, same steady sequence)

verified_equivalence.implication: the old arm-B runs used a model semantically equivalent to the frozen one, so their gate parameter setting is reproducible on the frozen model; the only remaining obstacle to re-running arm B is the stale decoupling_verification.json gate, not model semantics
